name: Exterior Porch Ceiling Surface Preparation
intent: Low-pressure wash, substrate-specific sanding (wood or FC), spot-prime tannin knots, caulk joints, dust cleanup. No end-seal (construction task).
doctrine: NC prep. Low-pressure wash only (NEVER power wash). Wood: 80-120 grit sand + spot-prime knots on cedar/redwood. FC: 150-grit scuff. No end-seal (construction task). Caulk panel joints + ceiling-to-trim junctions. Panel joints modifier on sand wood task. All overhead rates baked in.
